text:
Maya CSM: Starting Verdant onboarding thread. Goal: align stakeholders, finalize success metrics, and set a realistic 4-week plan. Kickoff Wed 9am PT. Please confirm availability and any prereqs. https://drive.redwood/verdant/onboard-intake :wave:
Liam Impl: Wed 9am PT works. I'll own sandbox provisioning and deployment checklist.
Sana SE: I'll run the integration demo. Requesting their infra contact and a staging API key beforehand.
Diego AE: Quick note from sales side: they requested detailed encryption and data handling docs. I can upload to the intake form but we might need legal sign-off.
Hannah PM: Suggest we make concrete success criteria: 1) sandbox calls succeed with sample traffic, 2) one feature toggled for beta users, 3) team walkthrough completed, 4) cost/perf baseline documented.
Maya CSM: Good list. Add observability + alerting configured as a soft success metric. Also capturing renewal risk: procurement timeline could push out pilot start.
Liam Impl: Proposed 4-week timeline: Week 0: access & SSO; Week 1: sandbox integration; Week 2: pilot behind flag; Week 3: monitoring + knowledge transfer; Buffer week for procurement.
Sana SE: Can we schedule a 20-min hands-on in the kickoff for live API calls? If keys not ready, I'll demo with recorded traces.
Diego AE: I'll chase procurement for SSO and SOC2 artifacts. ETA End of week. Flagging risk: if SOC2 takes >10 business days this becomes a blocker for production rollout.
Maya CSM: Action items: - Diego: procurement docs upload + procurement lead contact (ETA Thu) - Liam: infra checklist + sample payloads (ETA Tue) - Sana: demo script + test data requirements (ETA Tue) - Hannah: draft success criteria doc + rollout decision checklist (ETA Mon)
SchedulerBot: Event created: "Verdant Labs Onboarding - Kickoff" 2026-05-06 09:00 PT (invites sent)
Liam Impl: I'll paste a minimal checklist before EOD: ```- Invite IP ranges to allowlist
- Generate staging API key
- Seed sample requests
- Configure basic KV cache```
Sana SE: Also requesting a short list of customer personas to tailor the demo (ops, dev, product).
Maya CSM: I'll send an intake update asking for contacts, personas, compliance notes, and preferred SLAs. Please add any more items you want captured in the intake form in this thread.
Diego AE: Verdant specifically wants retention window options and encryption-at-rest details added. Adding to intake now.
Hannah PM: I'll prepare a 10-slide enablement deck focusing on rollback procedures and cost monitoring; will aim to share by Tue noon.
Maya CSM: Thanks all. I'll consolidate into the kickoff deck and circulate 24h before. If anyone sees blockers, ping me directly and I'll escalate. :thumbsup:
